name: Black Bear Diner (Draper) Sweet Cream Pancakes, Scrambled Eggs & Carved Roast Turkey Dinner
brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (12300 S · Draper & South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: Right across from TownePlace Suites Draper: Black Bear's famous Sweet Cream Pancakes, scrambled eggs, and slow-roasted Carved Turkey Dinner with mashed potatoes and a homemade biscuit are classic comfort food.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For breakfast, order the " Bear's Choice" with Sweet Cream Pancakes, scrambled eggs, and ham/bacon; for dinner, order the Roasted Turkey Dinner or Pot Roast with mashed potatoes and a cup of Chicken Noodle Soup.
watchOuts: Portions are huge—eat half and save the rest so you don't overload a sensitive stomach
